hero.eyebrow: Your fridge and house tasks, in one app
hero.titulo: No more asking what needs to get thrown out of the fridge, or whose turn it was to take out the trash.
hero.descripcion: Track what's in your fridge and the tasks that repeat every week. The app gives a heads-up — to you and whoever's turn it is — before something goes bad or a task slips through.
hero.esGratis: Free. Installs as an app on your phone, no app store needed.
hero.tiempoReal: Updates live for everyone in the house, no page refresh needed.
hero.google: Sign in directly with your Google account, no new password to create.
hero.sinAnuncios: No ads, and we never sell your data.

refri.titulo: Know what's about to expire before you open the fridge
refri.descripcion: Add what you buy — fruits and vegetables auto-fill how long they usually last. Every item sorts itself by urgency: expired, expiring today, or still good. Mark who each item belongs to, or leave it shared for the whole house.

compras.titulo: The grocery list everyone can see and check off
compras.descripcion: When something's running low in the fridge, send it to the list with one click. Anyone in the house can add items, check off what they bought, and clear the checked ones for the next trip with one button. If you're at the store and someone adds something from home, it shows up instantly.

gastos.titulo: Rent, electricity, groceries — without keeping score in your head
gastos.descripcion: Log what was paid and who paid it; the app splits it equally among everyone and instantly tells you who's owed and who owes. No more lost receipts in the group chat. You can also see a summary of what was spent each month, and log when someone already paid another person back.

tareas.titulo: Split up the chores without having the same argument every week
tareas.descripcion: Create tasks that repeat every few days, or on fixed days of the week — dishes on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, for example. Assign them to whoever's turn it is; once marked done, the app figures out on its own when they're due again, and everyone sees it update instantly. Got something that only happens once, like picking up a package on Saturday? Add it as a one-time event, with an optional date, and it deletes itself the moment you mark it done.

logros.titulo: A little nudge to stop putting off your tasks
logros.descripcion: Every task you complete on time earns a point and feeds your streak — just for you, so it feels like a personal win, not a competition against your roommates. No one else sees your number.

notas.titulo: The wifi password, in one place — not buried in a chat from 3 months ago
notas.descripcion: One shared note per house for whatever everyone needs handy: wifi, house rules, emergency contacts. Anyone can edit it, no digging through chat required.

avisos.titulo: We'll remind you — you don't have to remember
avisos.descripcion: The moment someone assigns you a task, you get notified instantly. Every morning, a summary of what's expiring in the fridge and what's on your plate that day — straight to your phone, like any other app. If someone owes you money, you can even mark it as paid with a button, without opening the app.

comoFunciona.paso1: Create your house, or join with a code someone shares with you — you can preview the house before you sign up.
comoFunciona.paso2: Add what's in the fridge, the shopping list, tasks, expenses, and house notes.
comoFunciona.paso3: Split it up, check things off, pay each other back — and let the app notify and update everyone live.

tiempoReal.descripcion: No one has to refresh the page — when someone checks something off, it updates on its own on every phone in the house.

comparacion.titulo: Why not just use something I already have?
comparacion.splitwiseDescripcion: Great at splitting expenses — but that's all it does. The fridge, tasks, and notes stay somewhere else, or nowhere.
comparacion.notionDescripcion: You can build anything there, but someone has to set up the system and keep it maintained — and in practice, your roommates aren't going to fill out a database every week.
comparacion.whatsappDescripcion: It's where household organizing actually lives today — which is why the wifi password is buried under memes from 3 months ago, and nobody knows if the electric bill got paid.
comparacion.cierre: RemindHome doesn't replace any of the three — it does all 4 things together, built specifically for living with roommates, and updates itself for everyone.

proximamente.descripcion: We keep building more for the home — more tailored notifications, and whatever you ask us for.

cta.titulo: Get started in under a minute
cta.descripcion: No card, no complicated install — it's added to your home screen like any other app.

Privacidad.intro: RemindHome is a small project built to organize your house's fridge and tasks. This notice explains, in plain language, what data we store and why.
Privacidad.queGuardamos1: Your email, the nickname you present yourself with in the app, and your password (stored encrypted, never in plain text).
Privacidad.queGuardamos2Post: , instead of asking you to type your name/email/password, we receive them directly from Google (your name, email, and profile photo). We don't share anything of yours with Google that Google didn't already know.
Privacidad.queGuardamos3: What you add: house names, members, fridge items, tasks, expenses, and notes.
Privacidad.queGuardamos4: If you turn on notifications, the technical information needed to send push alerts to that device.
Privacidad.paraQueTexto: Only to make the app work: showing you your fridge and tasks, sending the confirmation or password-recovery email, and notifying you when something expires or gets assigned to you. We don't sell or share your information with anyone for advertising.
Privacidad.conQuienIntro: With the providers that make the app possible, and only for that:
Privacidad.conQuienSupabaseDesc: stores the database and handles sign-in.
Privacidad.conQuienGoogleDesc: only if you choose “Continue with Google”, to confirm it's you.
Privacidad.conQuienVercelDesc: hosts the app and gives us anonymous visit stats (they don't identify anyone).

Privacidad.borrarPre: You can delete an entire house (and everything in it) yourself from
Privacidad.borrarPost: , if you're an admin. If you want us to delete your account and information entirely, write to us and we'll do it manually.
